text:
Asha: Heads-up — I opened a small PR to refresh the quickstart 'hello-minimal' tutorial. Goal: modernize auth examples, add a tiny Docker healthcheck, and fix two broken links. PR #7892.
Tom: Thanks. What are the auth changes?
Asha: Switched examples from long-lived API keys to the recommended ephemeral flow + env var helper. Inline snippet added for mac/linux: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(cat ~/.redwood/token)` and a short note about rotating keys.
Linh: Can we keep a one-liner for readers who just want to try it? maybe `REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_live... cargo run` (or the equiv for node/python)
Asha: Yep — added explicit single-line examples for node/python/go in a small "Quick test" box, plus the fuller helper below.
Kai: CI flagged a lint in the Dockerfile (had an extra apt-get update). I pushed a fixup to the branch. Also added `HEALTHCHECK CMD curl -f http://localhost:8080/health || exit 1` as requested.
Tom: Nice. Doc-bot: can you run the link-checker on the staged doc?
doc-bot: link-checker started for branch refresh/hello-minimal -> 12 links scanned, 2 broken (one external example, one internal anchor).
Asha: The external example link is to an old community gist — replaced with a snippet and removed the remote link. Internal anchor was renamed in a previous doc; updated to the correct id.
QA: Can someone add a tiny e2e smoke step to the PR checklist? I can run it after the fixes. Steps: build docker, run container, curl /health, then send a sample request using the one-liner.
Linh: I'll add the checklist item to the PR description and mark it as QA-needed. Also pinging @Tom for a docs review, @Kai for Docker signoff.
Tom: Reviewing now — mainly wording and a couple of grammar nits. I'll leave inline comments.
Kai: Docker build + healthcheck validated locally on macos and linux. No regressions.
Asha: Pushed edits addressing Tom's comments and the CI lint. Re-requested reviews.
doc-bot: CI: docs-lint passed, link-checker passed, docker-build passed, spellcheck flagged 1 British/US spelling inconsistency.
Tom: resolved the spelling choice in a tiny commit.
Asha: OK — unless anyone objects, I'll merge after QA confirms the smoke steps.
QA: Smoke test done ✅ container healthy and example request returned 200 with expected payload.
Kai: All set from infra side.
Tom: LGTM from docs.
Asha: Merging now — thanks all! :tada: If any follow-ups (extra language snippets or screenshots), open a new PR and tag me.
doc-bot: Merged by Asha into main (PR #7892).
